verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's own API documents programmatic management of API keys, so issuing credentials for an agent is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped or limited to least-privilege permissions, which is the core of this story. missing for 10: documented per-key permission scopes, least-privilege or read-only key types, agent-specific credential guidance (e.g., for MCP authentication), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
Build integrations and automate workflows with the Honeycomb API.
